label: Intrinsic commutator jet
title: D, G, Q and R are successive transport residuals
summary: Iterating C_H(A)=A∘H XOR H∘A gives D,G,Q,R as a same-lattice nonlinear jet. Rules 110 and 62 have symmetry-equivalent derivative maps but diverge at higher residuals; Rule 62 has a radius-3 local DG→Q factor while Rule 110 fails through radius 3.
takeaway: Future values and intrinsic residuals are alternate coordinates for missing temporal information, but nonlinear cadence changes introduce polarization terms. Finite jet closure on tested rings is mostly near-injective rather than compressive.
